meta.name: analyzing-dns-logs-for-exfiltration
meta.description: Analyzes DNS query logs to detect data exfiltration via DNS tunneling, DGA domain communication, and covert C2 channels using entropy analysis, query volume anomalies, and subdomain length detection in SIEM platforms. Use when SOC teams need to identify DNS-based threats that bypass traditional network security controls.

copy.tagline: 检测DNS隧道与数据泄露威胁
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是SOC分析师，需要从DNS日志中发现隐蔽数据泄露通道。
copy.tagline_en: Detect DNS tunneling and data exfiltration threats
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a SOC analyst needing to uncover covert data exfiltration channels from DNS logs.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析 DNS 查询日志，通过子域名长度、熵值、查询量等指标检测 DNS 隧道、DGA 域名和隐蔽 C2 通道，并给出疑似数据泄露的评估。
howto.when: 当 SOC 团队怀疑存在 DNS 隧道、DGA 通信或异常 DNS 查询量时，或威胁情报提示有 DNS 型 C2 通道时触发。

say.text: 分析最近24小时的DNS日志，找出可能的DNS隧道。
say.note: Claude 会执行子域名长度和熵值检测。

say.text: 检查这个IP的DNS查询量是否异常。
say.note: Claude 会计算Z分数并标记高查询量。
Claude 会分析域名熵值和元音比例。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes DNS query logs to detect DNS tunneling, DGA domains, and covert C2 channels using subdomain length, entropy, and query volume anomalies, then estimates potential data exfiltration.
howto.when_en: Triggered when SOC teams suspect DNS tunneling, DGA communication, or anomalous DNS query volumes, or when threat intelligence indicates DNS-based C2 channels.

say_en.text: Analyze DNS logs from the last 24 hours for possible tunneling.
say_en.note: Claude runs subdomain length and entropy checks.

say_en.text: Check if this IP has abnormal DNS query volume.
say_en.note: Claude calculates Z-scores and flags high counts.
Claude analyzes entropy and vowel ratio.
